summary: This video is a 3D animated educational film produced by NPCIL explaining the structure, components, working principles, fuel cycle, power generation, and safety systems of a 540 MW Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR) in India, intercut with live footage of plant exteriors, fuel handling, and environmental monitoring.

spans.shows: CGI graphics of outer space, Earth, atomic structures, orbiting electrons, and title graphics
spans.speech: Is duniya mein har ek cheez bani hai sookshma kanon se jinhe parmanu kehte hain.

spans.shows: Real footage of a nuclear power station exterior with cooling tower and palm trees
spans.speech: Kya aap jaante hain ki yeh parmanu kis cheez ka bana hua hai?

spans.shows: Real footage of nuclear power station exterior buildings near water and heavy construction excavators at work
spans.speech: Aise kendra nadi ya samudra jaise bade jalashayon ke samip sthapit kiye jaate hain.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: CGI 3D structural model of a 540 MW PHWR reactor building, containment structure dimensions, calandria, pressure tubes, fuelling machine, and fuel loading process
spans.onscreen_text: Ref: 540 MW Pressurized Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR), 50 meters, 56 meters, CALANDRIA, ALLOY OF ZIRCONIUM AND NIOBIUM, Calandria Tube, Coolant Tube / Pressure Tube
spans.speech: Thermal power plants yani taapiya vidyut kendron mein koyle jaise jivashm indhan ka istemal kiya jaata hai.

spans.shows: Real archive video of nuclear fuel manufacturing: worker opening a yellowcake drum and using tweezers to pick up a uranium fuel pellet
spans.speech: Khanij avastha se nikale gaye uranium se yellowcake banaye jaate hain.

spans.shows: CGI animations explaining nuclear fission chain reaction, control rods, primary heat transport system, steam generators, turbines, generator grid connection, safety shutoff systems, suppression pool, and animated control room
spans.onscreen_text: U235, U238, Fission, CADMIUM / COBALT, HPT, LPT 1, LPT 2, DEFENCE IN DEPTH, FAIL SAFE REDUNDANCY DIVERSITY
spans.speech: Is tarah parmanu reactor mein ek niyantrit parantu aatmanirbhar shrinkhla prakriya ki jaati hai.

spans.shows: Real shots of environmental monitoring around the nuclear plant: technician sampling soil and water, butterfly on a flower, kingfisher bird, cranes near water, and nilgai deer in wild grass
spans.place_people: environmental monitoring zone near nuclear plant
spans.speech: Har parmanu kendra ke aaspas ke paryavaran par vishesh dhyan diya jaata hai.
spans.fits: Rawatbhata town and the plant on the Rana Pratap Sagar lake / Chambal river (exteriors, the lake, birds)

spans.shows: CGI graphics of the 540 MW PHWR campus layout, atom graphic, and spinning Earth model
spans.speech: Is prakar se yeh hara-bhara kshetra anek jaati-prajaati ke jaanwaron tatha panchhiyon ke liye ek khushhal niwas ban jaata hai.

spans.shows: Real footage of a nuclear power plant exterior with cooling towers and landscaped gardens
spans.speech: Parmanu oorja ke bahut saare fayde hain. Isme sabse mahatvapurna baat yeh hai ki yeh ek carbon-mukt oorja ka srot hai.

spans.shows: CGI night cityscape, grid photo collage of Indian citizens, power line pylon, and NPCIL corporate logo graphics
spans.speech: Parmanu oorja ke upayog se na keval vartaman mein bijli sankat se nijaat paaya ja sakta hai, balki desh samriddhi ke maarg par prasashth hoga.
